xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Brandavan Foods Pvt. Ltd., Satyam Caterers, R.K. Associates
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
The Hon’ble Supreme Court, vide its judgment dated 07.11.2025, set aside the Delhi High Court’s Division Bench order dated 10.02.2025 and Single Judge orders dated 13.08.2024, along with the Arbitral Award dated 27.04.2022, in entirety.
The Apex Court held that the Arbitral Tribunal had exceeded its jurisdiction by disregarding the binding contractual terms and Railway Board circulars that expressly authorized IRCTC to modify menus and tariffs unilaterally. Court observed that both the claims regarding reimbursement of the second regular meal and supply of welcome drinks lacked contractual and legal basis, being contrary to governing circulars, and found the award patently illegal and against public policy under Sections 34(2A) and 34(2)(b)(ii) of the Arbitration Act, Accordingly, the Supreme Court allowed IRCTC’s appeals and dismissed all caterers’ claims, absolving IRCTC of any financial liability.
The matter now stands finally adjudicated by the Hon’ble Supreme Court in favour of IRCTC. Further No financial or operational impact arises on the Company.
Relevant details have been disclosed under Note 37.2 (iv) of Notes to Standalone financial statements in Company’s Annual Report for F.Y. 2024-25.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: There has been no change in status since the last disclosure dated 07.11.2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The matter was concluded and order from authority was awaited. However, National Anti Profiteering Authority (NAA) lost jurisdiction to adjudicate upon the matter with a notification dated 23.11.2022 effective from 1.12.2022 and now Competition Commission of India (CCI) has been vested with powers to adjudicate. No communication received from CCI till date. The disputed amount is Rs.50.41 Cr approx.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Subsequent to the change in Indian Tax regime, the matter is now pending with GSTAT. The same had also been disclosed in the notes to the Financial Statements for the Q2FY26 filed with exchanges on 12.11.2025. No material updation has been taken place in this case so far.
